invariants: FrontendComponent.declares == [] iff FrontendComponent.declaration_block == null (the component-level doc comment is the only source of `declares`; an element attribute never populates it)
FrontendComponent.screen != null iff FrontendComponent.role == 'page-root' (data-screen lives on the page root; a leaf component carries data-ac only)
FrontendComponent.framework is derived from the file extension: .tsx -> react-tsx, .jsx -> react-jsx, .vue -> vue-sfc, .svelte -> svelte, .html -> html
AcDeclaration.file resolves to a FrontendComponent.path

AcDeclaration.resolves == false iff AcDeclaration.unresolved_ids != [] — i.e. at least one member of ac_ids is absent from docs/acceptance-criteria/ (an unresolvable value is a DISTINCT verdict from a missing declaration, never folded into it)

AcDeclaration.attribute == 'data-ac' for every record — the pin is a data attribute, never a CSS class (class is the styling namespace and is purged/hashed by Tailwind content scanning and CSS modules)

AcDeclaration.test_selector == '[data-ac~="<ac_ids[0]>"]' — the selector a Playwright / Testing-Library test uses is mechanically derivable from the attribute value, so a check can assert the test's `covers:` id and the selector agree
AcDeclaration.screen_attr != null iff AcDeclaration.is_page_root == true, and it then equals its FrontendComponent.screen

AcDeclaration.ac_ids is a subset of its FrontendComponent.declares whenever that component has a declaration_block; when declaration_block == null the file is reported for the missing component-level floor instead
GuardrailFinding.verdict == 'block' implies GuardrailFinding.suppression_reason == null (a per-item opt-out downgrades to 'pass-with-reason'; it can never coexist with a block)
GuardrailFinding.verdict == 'pass-with-reason' implies GuardrailFinding.suppression_reason is a non-empty visible reason string

GuardrailFinding.code == 'missing-component-declaration' implies its subject FrontendComponent has declaration_block == null AND staged == true (an unchanged frontend file that merely lacks a declaration is never reported)
At most ONE GuardrailFinding exists per (subject, code) pair — a file that lacks its component declaration while also carrying an element data-ac yields one finding, not two (no double-reporting)
GuardrailFinding.tier == 'commit' subjects are FrontendComponent paths; GuardrailFinding.tier == 'ci' subjects are Ac ids (commit checks the forward direction, CI checks the reverse)
GuardrailFinding.verdict == 'warn' implies its subject FrontendComponent.tier == 'warn' (the warn tier is a deliberate per-path opt-in; block is the default)
GuardrailFinding.resolver == 'scripts/ac_store/ac_coverage_resolver.py' for every record — GE-111, GE-117 and this check share ONE AC-id resolver rather than each carrying a private copy
Ac.declaration_status == 'n-a' iff Ac.change_target != 'ui'

Ac.declaration_status == 'both' iff declared_by != [] and pinned_by != []; 'component' iff only declared_by != []; 'element' iff only pinned_by != []; 'undeclared' iff both are empty and change_target == 'ui'
Ac.change_target == 'ui' AND Ac.work_status == 'done' AND Ac.declaration_status == 'undeclared' implies exactly one ci-tier GuardrailFinding with code 'undeclared-done-ui-ac'

Ac.declaration_status != 'undeclared' does NOT imply Ac.covered_by != [] — a declaration is on-screen presence evidence, never coverage evidence, and may never substitute for a covering test (KM-ADM-004 is pinned at element level with covered_by == [])
Ac.declared_by members resolve to FrontendComponent.path; Ac.pinned_by members resolve to AcDeclaration.id

provenance.note: Created — no canonical dataset existed for guardrail-engine (index.json by_component.guardrail-engine had no mock_data, and FrontendComponent / AcDeclaration / GuardrailFinding were absent from by_entity). THE canonical dataset for the frontend AC-declaration guardrail: both declaration surfaces (component-level doc comment as the required floor, element-level data-ac as the optional pin), all four file types, and every enforcement state the checks must distinguish — block, warn-tier opt-in, per-item opt-out with a visible reason, unresolvable AC id as a verdict distinct from a missing declaration, an unchanged file that is never reported, and the reverse CI direction for a done change_target=ui AC. Element-level records deliberately keep covering_test null where no test exists, so the dataset cannot be read as making a data-ac substitute for coverage.
